use: Measure solution surface tension and critical micelle concentration (CMC).
simulation: Equilibrium / dynamic surface tension from a surfactant-mixture model (fitted to a built-in dataset).
notes: Pendant-drop optical tensiometer (reference: Biolin Theta Flex / Krüss DSA25 class; the Dutcher group's surface tension data also use the pendant-drop method). Specs not verified.
sources: Kleinheins, Marcolli, Dutcher & Shardt, PCCP 2024 (Zenodo 10550607): pendant-drop data, temperature 297.15 K
Pendant-drop method: Young–Laplace profile fit; typical uncertainty 0.1–0.2 mN/m
to_calibrate: Dynamic surface tension timescale at low concentration

comms.protocol: Vendor software (OneAttension / ADVANCE) export; or OpenCV contour + Young–Laplace fit

measure.description: Extrude a pendant drop from the sample cell on the instrument, wait drop_age_s, then image and fit the surface tension; repeat for `replicates` drops (low-concentration surfactants need longer drop age to equilibrate)
